title: Getting around: the interface
summary: The three areas of SquadHub — the icon bar, module sidebar, and content panel.

blocks.heading: The three-part layout
paragraphs: Every screen in SquadHub uses the same three-part structure. Once you know it, you can find anything.
1 — Icon bar: switch between the main modules. 2 — Module sidebar: navigate within the selected module. 3 — Content panel: view and complete the work you opened. There is no permanent right panel.

blocks.alt: The app interface with the icon bar, module sidebar, and content panel numbered 1 to 3
